_comment: BuildGraph SPARQL Benchmark — 75 queries across 5 categories. Scope features are auto-detected from each graph before execution. Expected 'non_empty' means result set has ≥1 row.
prefixes:
PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref:   <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
PREFIX meta:  <https://buildgraph.org/meta#>
PREFIX rdf:   <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

scope_checks.has_plant: ASK { { ?x a brick:Chiller } UNION { ?x a brick:Boiler } }
scope_checks.has_zone_sensors: ASK { ?z a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?z brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?z } . ?s a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor }
scope_checks.has_terminal_sensors: ASK { { ?t a brick:VAV } UNION { ?t a brick:Fan_Coil_Unit } . { ?t brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?t } . ?s a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor }

queries.nl: List all air handling units in the building
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:AHU }

queries.nl: List all VAV boxes
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:VAV }

queries.nl: List all fan coil units
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Fan_Coil_Unit }

queries.nl: List all chillers
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Chiller }

queries.nl: List all boilers
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Boiler }

queries.nl: List all supply fans
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Supply_Fan }

queries.nl: List all cooling coils
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Cooling_Coil }

queries.nl: List all cooling towers
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Cooling_Tower }

queries.nl: List all chilled water pumps
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Chilled_Water_Pump }

queries.nl: List all variable frequency drives
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Variable_Frequency_Drive }

queries.nl: List all floors in the building
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Floor }

queries.nl: List all HVAC zones
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:HVAC_Zone }

queries.nl: List all heat exchangers (energy recovery ventilators)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Heat_Exchanger }

queries.nl: List all electrical meters
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Electrical_Meter }
queries.notes: pre1980 buildings have no electric meter; scope=all so they naturally score 0

queries.nl: List all return fans
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?x WHERE { ?x a brick:Return_Fan }

queries.nl: Find supply air temperature sensors on AHUs (BAS hasPoint export style)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?ahu ?s WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . { ?ahu brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?ahu } . ?s a brick:Supply_Air_Temperature_Sensor }

queries.nl: Find CO2 sensors on HVAC zones (BAS hasPoint export style)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?z ?s WHERE { ?z a brick:HVAC_Zone . ?z brick:hasPoint ?s . ?s a brick:CO2_Sensor }
queries.notes: Tests standard and mixed rel_style only; inverse-style buildings score 0 here by design

queries.nl: Find CO2 sensors on HVAC zones (BAS isPointOf export style)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?z ?s WHERE { ?z a brick:HVAC_Zone . ?s brick:isPointOf ?z . ?s a brick:CO2_Sensor }
queries.notes: Tests inverse and mixed rel_style only; standard-style buildings score 0 here by design

queries.nl: Find zone cooling temperature setpoints
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?z ?sp WHERE { ?z a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?z brick:hasPoint ?sp } UNION { ?sp brick:isPointOf ?z } . ?sp a brick:Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint }

queries.nl: Find zone heating temperature setpoints
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?z ?sp WHERE { ?z a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?z brick:hasPoint ?sp } UNION { ?sp brick:isPointOf ?z } . ?sp a brick:Zone_Air_Heating_Temperature_Setpoint }

queries.nl: Find occupancy sensors on any HVAC zone
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?z ?s WHERE { ?z a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?z brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?z } . ?s a brick:Occupancy_Sensor }

queries.nl: Find all sensors with timeseries UUIDs (ingestion readiness check)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?s ?ts WHERE { ?s ref:hasExternalReference ?ref . ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts }

queries.nl: Find cooling and heating setpoints on VAV boxes
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?v ?sp WHERE { ?v a brick:VAV . { ?v brick:hasPoint ?sp } UNION { ?sp brick:isPointOf ?v } . { ?sp a brick:Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint } UNION { ?sp a brick:Zone_Air_Heating_Temperature_Setpoint } }

queries.nl: Find start/stop commands on supply fans
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?sf ?cmd WHERE { ?sf a brick:Supply_Fan . { ?sf brick:hasPoint ?cmd } UNION { ?cmd brick:isPointOf ?sf } . ?cmd a brick:Start_Stop_Command }

queries.nl: Find chilled water supply temperature sensors on chillers
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?c ?s WHERE { ?c a brick:Chiller . { ?c brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?c } . ?s a brick:Chilled_Water_Supply_Temperature_Sensor }

queries.nl: Find hot water supply temperature sensors on boilers
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?b ?s WHERE { ?b a brick:Boiler . { ?b brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?b } . ?s a brick:Hot_Water_Supply_Temperature_Sensor }

queries.nl: Find any sensor points on cooling coils
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?cc ?s WHERE { ?cc a brick:Cooling_Coil . { ?cc brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?cc } }

queries.nl: Find any sensor points on heating coils
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?hc ?s WHERE { ?hc a brick:Heating_Coil . { ?hc brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?hc } }

queries.nl: Find supply air temperature sensors on AHUs (BAS isPointOf export style)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?s ?ahu WHERE { ?s a brick:Supply_Air_Temperature_Sensor . ?s brick:isPointOf ?ahu . ?ahu a brick:AHU }
queries.notes: Only passes for inverse and mixed rel_style buildings

queries.nl: Find sensors consistent across both hasPoint and isPointOf (data quality check for ingestion)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?e ?s WHERE { ?e brick:hasPoint ?s . ?s brick:isPointOf ?e }
queries.notes: Only passes for mixed rel_style buildings; tests dataset relationship diversity

queries.nl: Find all zones served by any AHU
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?ahu ?zone WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . ?ahu brick:feeds+ ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone }

queries.nl: Find all VAV boxes and the zones they directly serve
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?vav ?zone WHERE { ?vav a brick:VAV . ?vav brick:feeds ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone }

queries.nl: Find return air temperature sensors on AHUs
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?ahu ?s WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . { ?ahu brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?ahu } . ?s a brick:Return_Air_Temperature_Sensor }

queries.nl: Find outside air temperature sensors on AHUs (economizer FDD signal)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?ahu ?s WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . { ?ahu brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?ahu } . ?s a brick:Outside_Air_Temperature_Sensor }

queries.nl: Find all VFDs and the equipment they control
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?vfd ?equip WHERE { ?vfd a brick:Variable_Frequency_Drive . ?vfd brick:controls ?equip }

queries.nl: Find zones reachable from a chiller through AHU (chiller feeds AHU feeds zone)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?chiller ?ahu ?zone WHERE { ?chiller a brick:Chiller . ?chiller brick:feeds+ ?ahu . ?ahu a brick:AHU . ?ahu brick:feeds+ ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone }

queries.nl: Find FCU terminals fed directly by a chiller (FCU-to-plant connection)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?chiller ?fcu WHERE { ?chiller a brick:Chiller . ?chiller brick:feeds+ ?fcu . ?fcu a brick:Fan_Coil_Unit }
queries.notes: Tests A3: FCU-to-plant connection

queries.nl: Find zones served by FCUs that are fed by a boiler
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?boiler ?fcu ?zone WHERE { ?boiler a brick:Boiler . ?boiler brick:feeds+ ?fcu . ?fcu a brick:Fan_Coil_Unit . ?fcu brick:feeds ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone }
queries.notes: Tests A3: boiler feeds FCU directly

queries.nl: Find chilled water pumps and the AHUs they feed
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?pump ?ahu WHERE { ?pump a brick:Chilled_Water_Pump . ?pump brick:feeds ?ahu . ?ahu a brick:AHU }
queries.notes: Tests A4: CHW pump loop connections

queries.nl: Find cooling towers that feed chillers
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?ct ?chiller WHERE { ?ct a brick:Cooling_Tower . ?ct brick:feeds ?chiller . ?chiller a brick:Chiller }

queries.nl: Find zones with direct zone-level air temperature sensors (demand-controlled ventilation scoping)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?zone ?s WHERE { ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?zone brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?zone } . ?s a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor }
queries.notes: Tests A7: zone-level sensor attachment

queries.nl: Find zones whose terminal unit has a zone air temperature sensor (mediated path)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?zone ?terminal ?s WHERE { ?terminal brick:feeds ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?terminal brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?terminal } . ?s a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor }

queries.nl: Find AHUs serving lobby zones (spatial zone type constraint)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?ahu ?zone WHERE { ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . ?zone meta:zoneType "lobby" . ?ahu brick:feeds+ ?zone . ?ahu a brick:AHU }
queries.notes: Tests A5: lobby on floor 1 only

queries.nl: Find the AHU to terminal unit to zone service path
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?ahu ?terminal ?zone WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . ?ahu brick:feeds ?terminal . ?terminal brick:feeds ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?terminal a brick:VAV } UNION { ?terminal a brick:Fan_Coil_Unit } }

queries.nl: Find AHUs with both supply air and return air temperature sensors
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?ahu WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . { ?ahu brick:hasPoint ?ss } UNION { ?ss brick:isPointOf ?ahu } . ?ss a brick:Supply_Air_Temperature_Sensor . { ?ahu brick:hasPoint ?rs } UNION { ?rs brick:isPointOf ?ahu } . ?rs a brick:Return_Air_Temperature_Sensor . FILTER(?ss != ?rs) }

queries.nl: Find AHUs with both supply air flow and static pressure sensors
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?ahu WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . { ?ahu brick:hasPoint ?fs } UNION { ?fs brick:isPointOf ?ahu } . ?fs a brick:Supply_Air_Flow_Sensor . { ?ahu brick:hasPoint ?ps } UNION { ?ps brick:isPointOf ?ahu } . ?ps a brick:Supply_Air_Static_Pressure_Sensor . FILTER(?fs != ?ps) }

queries.nl: Find VAV boxes with supply air flow sensors (airflow measurement at terminal)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?vav ?s WHERE { ?vav a brick:VAV . { ?vav brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?vav } . ?s a brick:Supply_Air_Flow_Sensor }

queries.nl: Find zones with both CO2 and occupancy sensors (demand-controlled ventilation candidate zones)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?zone WHERE { ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?zone brick:hasPoint ?co2 } UNION { ?co2 brick:isPointOf ?zone } . { ?zone brick:hasPoint ?occ } UNION { ?occ brick:isPointOf ?zone } . ?co2 a brick:CO2_Sensor . ?occ a brick:Occupancy_Sensor . FILTER(?co2 != ?occ) }

queries.nl: Find the chiller → CHW pump → AHU chain
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?chiller ?pump ?ahu WHERE { ?chiller a brick:Chiller . ?chiller brick:feeds ?pump . ?pump a brick:Chilled_Water_Pump . ?pump brick:feeds ?ahu . ?ahu a brick:AHU }
queries.notes: Tests A4: pump-inserted CHW loop

queries.nl: Find VAV boxes with zone air temperature sensors (terminal-attachment pattern)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?vav ?zone ?s WHERE { ?vav a brick:VAV . ?vav brick:feeds ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?vav brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?vav } . ?s a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor }
queries.notes: Tests the dominant real-world ZAT sensor attachment pattern: sensor on terminal, not on HVAC_Zone directly

queries.nl: Count terminal units served by each AHU
queries.sparql: SELECT ?ahu (COUNT(DISTINCT ?t) AS ?n) WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . ?ahu brick:feeds ?t . { ?t a brick:VAV } UNION { ?t a brick:Fan_Coil_Unit } } GROUP BY ?ahu HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?t) > 0)

queries.nl: Count zones served by each AHU
queries.sparql: SELECT ?ahu (COUNT(DISTINCT ?zone) AS ?n) WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . ?ahu brick:feeds+ ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone } GROUP BY ?ahu HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?zone) > 0)

queries.nl: Count sensor points per AHU
queries.sparql: SELECT ?ahu (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?n) WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . { ?ahu brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?ahu } } GROUP BY ?ahu HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) > 0)

queries.nl: Count zones that have at least one CO2 sensor
queries.sparql: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?zone) AS ?n) WHERE { ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?zone brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?zone } . ?s a brick:CO2_Sensor } HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?zone) > 0)

queries.nl: Count total number of chillers in the building
queries.sparql: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a brick:Chiller } HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) > 0)

queries.nl: Count pumps (CHW and HW) that have a VFD
queries.sparql: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?vfd a brick:Variable_Frequency_Drive . ?vfd brick:controls ?p . { ?p a brick:Chilled_Water_Pump } UNION { ?p a brick:Hot_Water_Pump } } HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p) > 0)

queries.nl: Count sensors with timeseries reference IDs (building-wide ingestion coverage rate)
queries.sparql: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s ref:hasExternalReference ?ref . ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts } HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) > 0)

queries.nl: Count distinct zone types present in the building
queries.sparql: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?zt) AS ?n) WHERE { ?z a brick:HVAC_Zone . ?z meta:zoneType ?zt } HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?zt) > 0)

queries.nl: Count sensor points per VAV terminal unit
queries.sparql: SELECT ?vav (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?n) WHERE { ?vav a brick:VAV . { ?vav brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?vav } } GROUP BY ?vav HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) > 0)

queries.nl: Count terminal units broken down by type (VAV vs FCU)
queries.sparql: SELECT ?type (COUNT(DISTINCT ?t) AS ?n) WHERE { { ?t a brick:VAV . BIND("VAV" AS ?type) } UNION { ?t a brick:Fan_Coil_Unit . BIND("FCU" AS ?type) } } GROUP BY ?type HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?t) > 0)

queries.nl: Find zones that share an AHU with a server room zone
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?zone WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . ?ahu brick:feeds+ ?srv . ?srv meta:zoneType "server_room" . ?ahu brick:feeds+ ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . FILTER(?zone != ?srv) }
queries.notes: Tests A1 (floor-band topology) — server rooms share AHU with nearby zones

queries.nl: Find zones with BOTH a direct zone temperature sensor AND a terminal-mediated one
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?zone WHERE { ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?zone brick:hasPoint ?s1 } UNION { ?s1 brick:isPointOf ?zone } . ?s1 a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor . ?terminal brick:feeds ?zone . { ?terminal brick:hasPoint ?s2 } UNION { ?s2 brick:isPointOf ?terminal } . ?s2 a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor . FILTER(?s1 != ?s2) }
queries.notes: Only possible after A7; tests that both zone-level and terminal-level sensors coexist

queries.nl: Find AHUs with supply, return, and outside air temperature sensors (comprehensive FDD instrumentation check)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?ahu WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . { ?ahu brick:hasPoint ?ss } UNION { ?ss brick:isPointOf ?ahu } . ?ss a brick:Supply_Air_Temperature_Sensor . { ?ahu brick:hasPoint ?rs } UNION { ?rs brick:isPointOf ?ahu } . ?rs a brick:Return_Air_Temperature_Sensor . { ?ahu brick:hasPoint ?os } UNION { ?os brick:isPointOf ?ahu } . ?os a brick:Outside_Air_Temperature_Sensor . FILTER(?ss != ?rs && ?rs != ?os && ?ss != ?os) }

queries.nl: Find the full chiller → pump → AHU → terminal → zone path
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?chiller ?zone WHERE { ?chiller a brick:Chiller . ?chiller brick:feeds ?pump . ?pump a brick:Chilled_Water_Pump . ?pump brick:feeds ?ahu . ?ahu a brick:AHU . ?ahu brick:feeds ?terminal . ?terminal brick:feeds ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone }
queries.notes: 4-hop path; requires both A3 and A4

queries.nl: Find zones reachable from any chiller that have an occupancy sensor
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?zone ?s WHERE { ?chiller a brick:Chiller . ?chiller brick:feeds+ ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?zone brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?zone } . ?s a brick:Occupancy_Sensor }
queries.notes: 5-hop traversal testing full graph connectivity

queries.nl: Find HVAC zones missing a direct zone temperature sensor (commissioning coverage gap)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?zone WHERE { ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . FILTER NOT EXISTS { { ?zone brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?zone } . ?s a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor } }
queries.notes: Informational: sparse-density buildings have some zones without sensors; tests NOT EXISTS pattern

queries.nl: Find sensors that have timeseries references AND whose equipment also has setpoints
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?equip ?sensor ?sp WHERE { { ?equip brick:hasPoint ?sensor } UNION { ?sensor brick:isPointOf ?equip } . ?sensor ref:hasExternalReference ?ref . ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts . { ?equip brick:hasPoint ?sp } UNION { ?sp brick:isPointOf ?equip } . { ?sp a brick:Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint } UNION { ?sp a brick:Supply_Air_Temperature_Setpoint } UNION { ?sp a brick:Chilled_Water_Supply_Temperature_Setpoint } }
queries.notes: Tests co-occurrence of timeseries refs and setpoints on same equipment

queries.nl: Find timeseries identifiers for sensors on VAV terminal units
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?vav ?s ?ts WHERE { ?vav a brick:VAV . { ?vav brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?vav } . ?s ref:hasExternalReference ?ref . ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts }

queries.nl: Find equipment that has control setpoints but no enable/disable command (commissioning completeness gap)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?equip WHERE { { ?equip brick:hasPoint ?sp } UNION { ?sp brick:isPointOf ?equip } . { ?sp a brick:Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint } UNION { ?sp a brick:Chilled_Water_Supply_Temperature_Setpoint } . FILTER NOT EXISTS { { ?equip brick:hasPoint ?cmd } UNION { ?cmd brick:isPointOf ?equip } . ?cmd a brick:Enable_Command } }
queries.notes: Tests NOT EXISTS + UNION; expects VAV boxes (have setpoints, no enable command)

queries.nl: Find all sensor points reachable from a chiller within two feeds hops
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?chiller ?equip ?s WHERE { ?chiller a brick:Chiller . ?chiller brick:feeds+ ?equip . { ?equip brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?equip } }

queries.nl: Find zones served by FCUs where the FCU is also fed by a chiller (hotel CHW pattern)
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?zone ?fcu ?chiller WHERE { ?chiller a brick:Chiller . ?chiller brick:feeds+ ?fcu . ?fcu a brick:Fan_Coil_Unit . ?fcu brick:feeds ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone }
queries.notes: Tests full A3 path: chiller → FCU → zone

queries.nl: Find AHUs whose terminal units have both timeseries sensors and temperature setpoints
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?ahu ?terminal WHERE { ?ahu a brick:AHU . ?ahu brick:feeds ?terminal . { ?terminal a brick:VAV } UNION { ?terminal a brick:Fan_Coil_Unit } . { ?terminal brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?terminal } . ?s ref:hasExternalReference ?ref . ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts . { ?terminal brick:hasPoint ?sp } UNION { ?sp brick:isPointOf ?terminal } . { ?sp a brick:Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint } UNION { ?sp a brick:Zone_Air_Heating_Temperature_Setpoint } . FILTER(?s != ?sp) }

queries.nl: Find timeseries IDs for all zone CO2 sensors
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?zone ?s ?ts WHERE { ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?zone brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?zone } . ?s a brick:CO2_Sensor . ?s ref:hasExternalReference ?ref . ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts }
queries.notes: 3-hop: zone → CO2 sensor → timeseries ref → ID

queries.nl: Find zones with BOTH zone-level setpoints and terminal-level setpoints
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?zone WHERE { ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?zone brick:hasPoint ?zsp } UNION { ?zsp brick:isPointOf ?zone } . { ?zsp a brick:Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint } UNION { ?zsp a brick:Zone_Air_Heating_Temperature_Setpoint } . ?terminal brick:feeds ?zone . { ?terminal brick:hasPoint ?tsp } UNION { ?tsp brick:isPointOf ?terminal } . { ?tsp a brick:Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint } UNION { ?tsp a brick:Zone_Air_Heating_Temperature_Setpoint } }
queries.notes: Tests dual-level setpoint attachment (zone-direct + terminal-mediated)

queries.nl: Find chiller path to zones with timeseries sensors on terminal units
queries.sparql: SELECT DISTINCT ?chiller ?zone ?ts WHERE { ?chiller a brick:Chiller . ?chiller brick:feeds+ ?ahu . ?ahu a brick:AHU . ?ahu brick:feeds ?terminal . ?terminal brick:feeds ?zone . ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone . { ?terminal brick:hasPoint ?s } UNION { ?s brick:isPointOf ?terminal } . ?s ref:hasExternalReference ?ref . ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts }
queries.notes: 5-hop traversal ending with timeseries sensor on terminal; tests full graph connectivity with timeseries integration
